old_failure_mode: Test was machine-dependent because it only set OSM2WORLD_HOME to a nonexistent path, but the production resolver has fallbacks to <repo>/carla_governed/OSM2World-latest-bin and <repo>/OSM2World-latest-bin. If either existed on the test machine, the test would incorrectly pass (or fail to catch the negative control).
new_isolation_method: Monkeypatch cook_mod.REPO_ROOT to an empty temporary repo root containing neither carla_governed/OSM2World-latest-bin nor OSM2World-latest-bin. Set OSM2WORLD_HOME to a nonexistent temp path. Call _require_osm2world_home(None, ...). Assert precise SystemExit with required message fields.
